title: Children Sing
content:
1.
Children sing! Children sing! 
Happy praises to our King! 
Gladly raise, gladly raise 
joyful songs of praise! 
Jesus is the children’s friend, 
He’ll be with us to the end; 
Children sing! Children sing! 
Praises to our King!

2.
Children sing! Children sing! 
Happy praises to our King! 
Gladly raise, gladly raise 
joyful songs of praise! 
Jesus made the birds and flowers 
And this wondrous world of ours; 
Children sing! Children sing! 
Praises to our King!

3.
Children sing! Children sing! 
Happy praises to our King! 
Gladly raise, gladly raise 
joyful songs of praise! 
Jesus leads us ev’ry day, 
Always in the heav’nly way; 
Children sing! Children sing! 
Praises to our King!
rights: Used by permission of Standard Publishing Co.

source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls

title: Good Morning, Ev’rybody
content:
1.
Good morning ev’rybody, 
We’re happy to be here! 
Good morning to you, children, 
Good morning teachers dear! 
Good morning, ev’rybody, 
We’ll smile and sweetly sing 
Our loving song to Jesus, 
Good morning to our King!

2.
This is the blessed Sabbath, 
Of all the week the best. 
We meet to learn of Jesus, 
As from our play we rest. 
Good morning, ev’rybody, 
We’ll smile and sweetly sing 
Our loving song to Jesus, 
Good morning to our King!
rights: Copyright, 1930, by Genevieve Mead. Used by permission.
score: musicxml/Happy Songs for Boys and Girls/002_Good_Morning_Everybody.musicxml
source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls

title: All the Children Praise the Lord
content:
All the children praise the Lord, 
Praise the Lord, Praise the Lord. 
All the children, praise the Lord, 
Praise ye the Lord.
rights: Beginners’ Songs, by David C. Cook. (Adapted.)
source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls

title: Always Cheerful
content:
1.
Let our hearts be always cheerful; 
Why should murm’ring enter there, 
When our kind and loving Father 
Makes us children of His care?

Chorus
Always cheerful, always cheerful, 
Sunshine all around we see; 
Full of beauty is the path of duty, 
Cheerful we may always be.

2.
With His gentle hand to lead us, 
Should the pow’rs of sin assail, 
He has promised grace to help us; 
Never can His promise fail. 

3.
When we turn aside from duty, 
Comes the pain of doing wrong; 
And a shadow, creeping o’er us, 
Checks the rapture of our song. 

4.
Oh! the good are always happy, 
And their path is ever bright; 
Let us heed the blessed counsel, 
Shun the wrong and love the right.
score: musicxml/Happy Songs for Boys and Girls/004_Always_Cheerful.musicxml
source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls

title: I Was Glad
content:
I was glad when they said unto me, 
Let us go unto the house of the Lord. 
I was glad when they said unto me, 
Let us go unto the house of the Lord.

title: Ten Commandments Song
content:
1.
Thou shalt not have, so says the Lord, 
Before Me any other God. 

2.
Thou shalt not make nor worship one; 
I am thy God and I alone. 

Chorus
Ten Commandments sent from heav’n, 
God to me each one has giv’n; 
All of these I will obey, 
Walking thus in wisdom’s way.

3.
Thou shalt not take My name in vain, 
Else guiltless thou shalt not remain. 

4.
Always remember, this obey, 
Holy to keep the Sabbath day. 

Chorus
Ten Commandments sent from heav’n, 
God to me each one has giv’n; 
All of these I will obey, 
Walking thus in wisdom’s way.

5.
Thy father and thy mother too, 
Thou shalt do honor and be true. 

6.
Thou shalt not kill, but rather give 
Out of thy love that all may live. 

Chorus
Ten Commandments sent from heav’n, 
God to me each one has giv’n; 
All of these I will obey, 
Walking thus in wisdom’s way.

7.
To base desire thou shalt not yield; 
God’s Word on this shall be revealed. 

8.
Thou shalt not steal nor take away 
That which is not thine own alway. 

Chorus
Ten Commandments sent from heav’n, 
God to me each one has giv’n; 
All of these I will obey, 
Walking thus in wisdom’s way.

9.
False witness thou must never bear; 
God’s Word on this is very clear. 

10.
Thou shalt not covet; this is wrong 
If to another it belong. 

Chorus
Ten Commandments sent from heav’n, 
God to me each one has giv’n; 
All of these I will obey, 
Walking thus in wisdom’s way.
rights: Copyright, 1916; Renewal, 1944. The Rodeheaver Co., Owner. International copyright secured. Used by permission.
score: musicxml/Happy Songs for Boys and Girls/006_Ten_Commandments_Song.musicxml
source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls

title: Jesus Loves the Children
content:
1.
Jesus loves the children 
Such as you and me. 
Jesus wants the boys and girls 
For His family. 

Chorus
Ev’ry boy and girl should be 
Part of Jesus’ family. 
Ev’ry boy and girl should be 
Part of Jesus’ family.

2.
Jesus gives us sunshine 
And the sky above. 
Jesus gives us flowers, 
For they show His love.
rights: Copyright, 1952, by the Review and Herald Pub. Assn.
source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls

title: Lord, Teach a Little Child to Pray
content:
1.
Lord, teach a little child to pray, 
And, oh, accept my prayer; 
Thou hearest all the words I say, 
for Thou art ev’rywhere. 

Chorus
A little sparrow cannot fall 
Unnoticed, Lord by Thee; 
And though I am so young and small, 
Thou dost take care of me.

2.
Teach me to do whate’er is right, 
And when I sin, forgive; 
And make it still my chief delight
to serve Thee while I live.
rights: Copyright, 1952, by the Review and Herald Pub. Assn.
source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls

title: Come to My Heart
content:
Come to my heart, blessed Jesus, 
Come now by Thy Spirit divine. 
I open the door now in welcome; 
O come to this heart of mine. Amen.
rights: Copyright, 1952, by the Review and Herald Pub. Assn.
score: musicxml/Happy Songs for Boys and Girls/010_Come_to_My_Heart.musicxml
source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls

title: Little Child’s Belief
content:
1.
I believe in God the Father, 
Who made us ev’ry one, 
Who made the earth and heaven. 
The moon and stars and sun; 
All that we have each day, 
To us by Him is giv’n; 
We call Him when we pray, 
“Our Father in the heav’n.”

2.
I believe in Jesus Christ, 
The Father’s only Son, 
Who came to us from heaven, 
And loved us ev’ry one; 
He taught us to be holy, 
Till on the cross He died; 
And now we call Him Saviour, 
And Christ the crucified.

3.
I believe God’s Holy Spirit 
Is with us ev’ry day; 
And if we do not grieve Him, 
He will ne’er go away; 
From heaven upon Jesus 
He de-scend ed like a dove; 
And He dwell-eth ever with us 
To fill our hearts with love.
score: musicxml/Happy Songs for Boys and Girls/011_Little_Childs_Belief.musicxml
source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls

title: We Sing
content:
1.
Our sweetest songs of gladness, 
On this delightful day,
We bring to praise the Saviour, 
Who is the Life, the Way. 

Chorus
We sing, we sing
The we sing praises of our King,
We sing, we sing 
The glory of our King.

2.
He lov’d the little children, 
When He was here below, 
And tho’ He’s up in heaven, 
He loves us yet we know.

3.
We love to sing His praises 
And hear the stories told, 
Of Him when He was dwelling 
In Galilee of old.

4.
O Saviour, blessed Saviour, 
We kneel before Thy throne, 
And ask that Thou wilt help us 
To live for Thee alone.
score: musicxml/Happy Songs for Boys and Girls/012_We_Sing.musicxml
source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls

title: With Folded Hands
content:
With folded hands and heads bowed down, 
Dear Lord, we come today; 
Help us to think of Thee alone, 
And teach us how to pray. Amen.
rights: Used by permission of Standard Publishing Company.
score: musicxml/Happy Songs for Boys and Girls/015_With_Folded_Hands.musicxml
source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls

title: Birthday Song
content:
1. 
Spring
When blossoms are blowing 
and little bees hum, 
When green grass is growing 
And springtime is come, 

Chorus
Someone has a birthday, 
Someone we know, too! 
Happy birthday, dear 
Happy birthday, to you.

2.
Summer
When sunshine is golden, 
And skies blue and clear, 
When roses are blooming, 
And summer is here,

3.
Autumn
When brown nuts are falling, 
And leaves turning red, 
When flowers are going 
To their winter bed,

4.
Winter
When snowflakes are flying 
So softly and white, 
And Jack Frost is painting 
The windows at night,
rights: Copyright, 1952, by the Review and Herald Pub. Assn.
score: musicxml/Happy Songs for Boys and Girls/016_Birthday_Song.musicxml
source: Happy Songs for Boys and Girls
